            for dy in range(1 - b["h"], a["h"]):
                for dx in range(1 - b["w"], a["w"]):
                    score = 0
                    valid = True
                    for (y, x), color in a["cells"].items():
                        other = b["cells"].get((y - dy, x - dx))
                        if other is not None:
                            if other != color:
                                valid = False
                                break
                            score += 1
                    if valid and score:
                        key = (score, -(abs(dx) + abs(dy)))
                        if best is None or key > best[0]:
                            best = (key, dx, dy)
            if best and best[0][0] >= 2:
                score, dx, dy = best[0][0], best[1], best[2]
                edges[i].append((score, j, dx, dy))
                edges[j].append((score, i, -dx, -dy))

    groups = []
    visited = set()
    for start in range(len(pieces)):
        if start in visited:
            continue
        stack, group = [start], []
        visited.add(start)
        while stack:
            u = stack.pop()
            group.append(u)
            for _, v, _, _ in edges[u]:
                if v not in visited:
                    visited.add(v)
                    stack.append(v)
        groups.append(group)

    group = max(groups, key=lambda g: (sum(pieces[i]["area"] for i in g), len(g)))
    root = max(group, key=lambda i: pieces[i]["area"])
    pos = {root: (0, 0)}
    q = deque([root])

    while q:
        u = q.popleft()
        ux, uy = pos[u]
        for score, v, dx, dy in sorted(edges[u], key=lambda e: -e[0]):
            if v in group and v not in pos:
                pos[v] = (ux + dx, uy + dy)
                q.append(v)

    minx = min(pos[i][0] for i in group)
    miny = min(pos[i][1] for i in group)
    maxx = max(pos[i][0] + pieces[i]["w"] - 1 for i in group)
    maxy = max(pos[i][1] + pieces[i]["h"] - 1 for i in group)
    out = [[bg] * (maxx - minx + 1) for _ in range(maxy - miny + 1)]

    for i in group:
        ox, oy = pos[i]
        for (y, x), color in pieces[i]["cells"].items():
            out[oy + y - miny][ox + x - minx] = color
    return out
